text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Through this race, I learn that I barely<n>have enough
stamina to finish<n>running a single mile. It seems
sprints<n>are my better bet.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I can feel it in my very bones. If I run<n>in the
1,300-meter Prix Maurice de<n>Gheest, I'll be sure to
claim my very<n>first European G1 victory.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But I can't simply run away from<n>racing against
Taiki. No, I must go<n>against my destiny in order to
surpass it in the future!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I hereby renounce the Prix Maurice<n>de Gheest!
